input: the same four actual orthographic RGB views represented by one frozen global-average-pooled ResNet-50 feature token per view
target: masked named neckline/front-back-armhole/sleeve-head landmarks, scale metrics, and two-cubic semantic-path formulas
feature_encoder_description: frozen local Mask R-CNN v2 ResNet-50 global-average-pooled to one 2048D token/view
trainable_description: shared memory Transformer + the same five target-specific role queries + the same landmark/metric/two-cubic heads
ablation_contract: Same samples, official splits, five queries, 16 targets, decoder depth/width/heads, losses, optimizer, schedule, dropout, and seed as the FPN run; within-view spatial tokens are replaced by one existing global token per view.
notes: The feature archive is a lossless singleton-token-axis conversion of the already extracted [N,4,2048] float16 archive.
No images or backbone features are recomputed for this ablation.

The 2048-to-256 input projection differs in shape from the FPN 256-to-256 projection because the required existing global feature has 2048 channels; all downstream Transformer and prediction heads are unchanged.
